confidence_scope: High for frozen-run accounting and descriptive verdict; medium for repeatable scientific benefit beyond one training seed.

C1.scope: Only the frozen single-training-seed combined-method comparison on 48 existing VAL tasks and two paired sampling seeds.
C1.what_results_support: Unguided eligibility 9/96 to 24/96, 15 gained and zero lost hits; position improves in 84/96 pairs; empirical position, rotation and Q tails decrease.
C1.what_results_dont_support: Population tail guarantees, high-reliability unguided planning, independent training reproducibility, or isolated teacher/world-gradient causality.
missing_evidence: Separate teacher-only and world-only controls if component attribution is desired
C1.suggested_claim_revision: For one matched training seed and the frozen 48-task two-sampling-seed VAL set, combined full-DDIM teacher and world-endpoint alignment raised unguided eligibility from 9/96 to 24/96 and reduced observed error tails.

C2.what_results_support: Both new methods retain 180/180 candidate and 36/36 execution success on original DEV; aligned has 5/5 candidates and one verified selected execution in the fixed three-obstacle static pregrasp scene.
C2.what_results_dont_support: Improved complete planning in general, success-rate advantage, consistent position advantage, five-obstacle application readiness, dynamic or contact capture.
missing_evidence: A legal five-obstacle trajectory and execution witness
Consistent complete-planning gains across independent tasks and training replicates
C2.suggested_claim_revision: The combined training package preserves original-DEV engineering success and works in one fixed three-obstacle static pregrasp scene, but the five-obstacle application remains unsolved under the frozen budget.

extra_review_checks: All 62 saved central/fine convergence pose differences independently recalculated
Raw statistics, paired variations and application failure gates independently recomputed
Original DEV task reuse identity and 1403-entry before/after completed-resume manifests inspected

runtime_reproducibility_caveat.initial_unmatched_environment_audit: FAIL at aligned update 0020 normalized prepared-output equality
runtime_reproducibility_caveat.resolution: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS to 2 before numerical imports, and torch threads to 2 as in original worker. Complete saved-only audit then passes; no tolerance or source edits.

engineering.replay_evidence_limit: Native arrays and replay summary/source are verified; a complete separate second replay trajectory is not stored and no new physical replay was run.

application.scope: Static noncontact pregrasp approach plus hold, APPLICATION_DEV
application.three_obstacles_mean_failure: All five fail geometry_refinement: 2.115–2.227 mm steps exceed 2 mm, despite positive sampled clearance 6.907–8.465 mm and passing pose.
application.five_obstacle_feasibility: Unestablished; bounded failures do not prove infeasibility.

TEST.reason: Aligned five-obstacle candidates are 0/5 and no selected execution exists; required >=4/5 and selected execution/replay pass in both scenes are not met.

what_results_support: A bounded empirical unguided improvement for the combined training change and completed original-DEV engineering validation.
what_results_dont_support: General complete-planning superiority, two-scene application readiness, or TEST readiness.
missing_evidence: Independent training repetitions, unseen scene generalization, component attribution, and a legal five-obstacle path/execution witness.
next_bounded_action: Close this frozen run with narrowed C1 and negative C2/application conclusions; use saved collision pairs, constraints and fallback traces to prepare a separate bounded feasibility/guidance diagnostic proposal. Do not start TEST, expand data, relax gates or add simulations in this review.
next_experiments_needed: For a future separately authorized protocol: distinguish five-obstacle path feasibility from bounded planner failure before further training; independent training repetitions and component controls are needed only for broader scientific claims.
